Shirley N. Weber* Democratic
California Secretary of State
Voters elected her for a full term on November 8, 2022.

Shirley Nash Weber, Ph.D., was nominated to serve as California Secretary of State by Governor Gavin Newsom on December 22, 2020 and sworn into office on January 29, 2021. Voters elected her for a full term on November 8, 2022.
In 2012, Dr. Weber was elected to the California State Assembly, representing Assembly District 79.
Before her appointment, Dr. Weber served four terms as an Assemblymember representing California's 79th Assembly District
